summary.scope: EP02 Scene09 mock battle start/keyframe secondary visual QA
summary.policy: Pass requires qa_passed production status, qa_passed manifest status, existing 16:9 raster start/key PNGs, four or more QA checks, and recorded start-key association. This is file-delivery QA, not creative/cinematic approval.
summary.remaining_video_gate: Generate motion samples before treating any shot as final video-ready.
